shots.text: Fire ants rule through fear.
Their venom burns for days, and their queen hasn't left her chamber in three years.
But I was faster than their venom.
Over the next weeks I climbed their ranks.
I {snap}snapped the jaws of every soldier who challenged me, until no one challenged me anymore.
They stopped calling me trap-jaw. They started calling me *Lord Mandros*.
Then the general who made me a soldier started to fear me.
So did the queen.
One night she sent twenty of her best to kill me while I slept.
They didn't know I don't really sleep anymore.
I heard them three tunnels away.
I let them get close. Close enough to see my eyes glow green in the dark.
Then I {impact}moved.
In the morning, I walked into the royal chamber alone, covered in red.
The general was already dead at the door.
The queen looked at me and whispered, "What are you?"
I told her the truth.
"I'm number 250. And this is my colony now."
The whole army bowed. Thousands of them.
Behind me, my own kind, the trap-jaws, were still in chains.
The old worker pushed to the front and begged, "Free us. Please. You're one of us."
I looked at him for a long time.
Then I turned to my new soldiers and said, "Make them dig deeper."
I could've freed them.
I didn't. Not yet. Maybe not ever.
